# Complete minimal React/Vite example

Assumes source `en`, target `fr`, compiled JSONL catalogs, and `vite/client` types.

## i18n.config.ts

```ts
import { defineConfig } from '@fluentic/i18n-cli';

export default defineConfig({
  compiled: true,
  catalogFormat: 'jsonl',
  output: 'i18n',
  languages: { source: 'en', targets: ['fr'] },
  files: { includes: ['src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'] },
});
```

## vite.config.ts

```ts
import fluentic from '@fluentic/i18n-compiler/vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [fluentic({ config: './i18n.config.ts' }), react()],
});
```

## src/i18n.ts

```ts
import { defineTranslationLoader } from '@fluentic/i18n';
import {
  createLocalStorage,
  createTranslationCacheLoader,
  I18nManager,
} from '@fluentic/i18n-web';

export const languages = [
  { id: 'en', label: 'English' },
  { id: 'fr', label: 'Français' },
] as const;

const loader = defineTranslationLoader({
  en: [],
  fr: () => import('../i18n/translations/fr/merged.jsonl?raw'),
});

export const cache = createTranslationCacheLoader(loader, {
  hash: () => import('../i18n/translations/hash.json'),
  storageKey: 'example:i18n:catalogs',
});

I18nManager.configure({ languageId: 'en', fallbackLanguageId: 'en' });
I18nManager.setStorage(createLocalStorage());
I18nManager.setTranslationLoader(cache.loader);

export const initializeI18n = () => I18nManager.init();
```

## src/main.tsx

```tsx
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { App } from './App';
import { initializeI18n } from './i18n';

const root = document.getElementById('root');
if (!root) throw new Error('Missing root');

initializeI18n().then(
  () => createRoot(root).render(<App />),
  (error) => {
    console.error(error);
    root.textContent = 'Unable to load the application.';
  },
);
```

## src/App.tsx

```tsx
import { t } from '@fluentic/i18n';
import { I18nManager, I18nState } from '@fluentic/i18n-web';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { languages } from './i18n';

const greeting = t.msg('Welcome back, {name}!', { name: String });

export function App() {
  const state = I18nState.use();
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.lang = state.languageId;
  }, [state.languageId]);

  async function switchLanguage(languageId: string) {
    try {
      setFailed(false);
      await I18nManager.setLanguageId(languageId);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      setFailed(true);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main>
      <h1>{t.jsx(greeting, { name: 'Ada' })}</h1>

      <label htmlFor='language'>{t.jsx('Language')}</label>
      <select
        id='language'
        value={state.languageId}
        disabled={state.isLoading}
        onChange={(event) => void switchLanguage(event.target.value)}
      >
        {languages.map((language) => (
          <option key={language.id} value={language.id}>{language.label}</option>
        ))}
      </select>

      {t.jsx(() => (
        <input
          placeholder={t.text('Search projects')}
          aria-label={t.text('Search projects')}
        />
      ))}

      {failed && <p role='alert'>{t.jsx('Could not load translations. Please try again.')}</p>}
    </main>
  );
}
```

`App` rerenders because it consumes language/loading state. The callback example demonstrates a reusable fine-grained boundary; use it in a child that does not otherwise subscribe to see the parent-rerender optimization.

## Translation commands

```sh
pnpm i18n:extract
# Add French text to i18n/translations/fr/manual.jsonl
pnpm i18n:merge
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
```
